heading: About Me
paragraphs: I'm **Tanzamul**, a **Full-Stack Developer** and **Generative AI researcher** in Dhaka. I'm finishing my CSE degree at **United International University**, with a major in Data Science.

My projects have taken me from legal-aid dashboards to radiology interfaces and digital wedding invitations. I enjoy the decisions in between: what someone needs to see first, how a screen should respond, and what the backend needs to make that interaction work.

Lately, I've been studying **LLM reasoning and agent security**, especially what happens when an agent trusts a tool response it shouldn't. Away from the code, I tutor mathematics and science for school and university admission students. Explaining a difficult idea clearly is a challenge I keep coming back to.
